disorder-name.detail: Mild cognitive impairment patients from ADNI3 and OASIS3 (anomaly detection experiment) and NIMHANS (model adaptation experiment). All referred to as 'MCI' in the paper.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "ADNI3 and OASIS3 included patients with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and dementia. [...] the NIMHANS elderly cohort has MCI and dementia participants"

dataset-of-origin.detail: Three datasets provided MCI clinical cases: ADNI3 (N=214) and OASIS3 (N=11) used for anomaly detection, NIMHANS (N=89) used for model adaptation. Total clinical MCI N=314.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "the patients in ADNI3 and OASIS3 were included as test data for the anomaly detection experiment. [...] Two additional datasets were used for the model adaptation experiments: the National Institute of Mental Health and Neuro Sciences (NIMHANS) dataset"

answer.note: weighted mean of medians; pooled SD

age.detail: The paper reports Median Age (SD), not Mean Age. Values used as proxies: ADNI3 MCI (N=214, median=75.4, SD=8.0, range 55-93), OASIS3 MCI (N=11, median=76.8, SD=7.5, range 62-87), NIMHANS MCI (N=89, median=68.0, SD=7.4, range 52-88). Weighted mean of medians = (214×75.4 + 11×76.8 + 89×68.0)/314 = 73.35 (weighted). Pooled SD = sqrt((213×64 + 10×56.25 + 88×54.76)/311) = 7.82 (pooled). Combined min=52, max=93.

sex.detail: Males calculated from reported percentages: ADNI3 MCI 57% of 214 ≈ 122 males; OASIS3 MCI 36% of 11 ≈ 4 males; NIMHANS MCI 65% of 89 ≈ 58 males. Total males = 184, females = 314 - 184 = 130. Percentages derived from totals.

disorder-name.detail: Dementia patients from ADNI3 and OASIS3 (anomaly detection experiment) and NIMHANS (model adaptation experiment). The paper labels these as 'Dementia'; ADNI3 context is Alzheimer's disease-focused but the clinical label used throughout is 'dementia'.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "ADNI3 and OASIS3 included patients with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and dementia. [...] the NIMHANS elderly cohort has MCI and dementia participants"

dataset-of-origin.detail: Three datasets provided dementia clinical cases: ADNI3 (N=69) and OASIS3 (N=12) used for anomaly detection, NIMHANS (N=90) used for model adaptation. Total dementia clinical N=171.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "the patients in ADNI3 and OASIS3 were included as test data for the anomaly detection experiment. [...] Two additional datasets were used for the model adaptation experiments: the National Institute of Mental Health and Neuro Sciences (NIMHANS) dataset"

answer.note: weighted mean of medians; pooled SD

age.detail: The paper reports Median Age (SD), not Mean Age. Values used as proxies: ADNI3 Dementia (N=69, median=78, SD=8.8, range 55-95), OASIS3 Dementia (N=12, median=76.1, SD=5.1, range 65-82), NIMHANS Dementia (N=90, median=70.5, SD=7.4, range 51-86). Weighted mean of medians = (69×78 + 12×76.1 + 90×70.5)/171 = 73.92 (weighted). Pooled SD = sqrt((68×77.44 + 11×26.01 + 89×54.76)/168) = 7.88 (pooled). Combined min=51, max=95.

sex.detail: Males calculated from reported percentages: ADNI3 Dementia 59% of 69 ≈ 41 males; OASIS3 Dementia 41% of 12 ≈ 5 males; NIMHANS Dementia 58% of 90 ≈ 52 males. Total males = 98, females = 171 - 98 = 73. Percentages derived from totals.

disorder-name.detail: 22q11.2 deletion syndrome patients from the UCLA neurogenetic dataset, used for model adaptation experiment. Referred to as '22q11.2 Del. S.' and '22qDel' in the paper.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "the UCLA neurogenetic dataset has 22qDel participants and age-matched healthy controls"

dataset-of-origin.detail: UCLA 22q11.2 CNV/Neurogenetic Dataset. The paper cites this as 'the 22q11.2 copy number variant (CNV) dataset from the University of California Los Angeles (UCLA)' with references [67,68].
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "the 22q11.2 copy number variant (CNV) dataset from the University of California Los Angeles (UCLA)"

age.detail: The paper reports Median Age (SD), not Mean Age. UCLA 22q11.2 Del. S.: N=80, age range 6-27, median age=14.0 (SD=6.1). Single dataset; no combining required.

sex.detail: 46% of 80 = 36.8 ≈ 37 males; females estimated as 80 - 37 = 43. Percentages derived from counts.
